name: Tetris Effect: Mixed Realities
summary:
A mind-blowing reinvention of Tetris® Effect that uses the full power of MR and Tetris’ absorbing gameplay to transport you into magical, musical realms. Your room transforms into a deep-sea aquarium, remote space station, and more, as you build—Tetrimino by Tetrimino—gateways to other dimensions that blur the line between the real and the virtual.
